name: Zakynthos
tagline: Shipwreck Beach, sea caves and loggerhead turtles
summary: Zakynthos is an Ionian island of white cliffs and electric-blue water. See the famous Shipwreck Beach of Navagio from the cliff-top viewpoint or by boat, swim inside the Blue Caves, spot loggerhead turtles in Laganas Bay, and taste the island's Venetian-era food and music in the villages.
seasonNote: June and September are ideal; Laganas is party-busy in July and August.
arrival: Direct summer flights from much of Europe; ferries from Kyllini on the mainland take 1 hour.
gettingAround: Rent a car or scooter; boat trips for Navagio and the caves.
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted, but carry cash for tavernas, kiosks and beach loungers. Tip 5 to 10 percent.
foodTip: Sartsa beef stew, ladotyri cheese, mandolato nougat and Verdea wine.
buyTip: Mandolato nougat and local olive oil.

connections.note: Daily flights; or bus and ferry via Kyllini.
